calibration.description: one fault-free run per task measured the turn requirement used for the budgeted condition (see --mode calibrate)

fault_injection.model: deterministic transient fault epochs: the first N attempts of a faulted logical call fail (timeout / HTTP 429 / HTTP 5xx), then the real call runs
fault_injection.note: fault surface is seeded per (function, arguments) and identical across arms

protocol.verification: programmatic; ground truth computed from the same live APIs before the runs
protocol.task_requirements: each task needs dependent cross-tool calls over 2-6 stages

key_findings: budgeted: task success baseline 8/20 vs guard 19/20 (McNemar exact p=0.0034)
budgeted: turns 85 -> 68, tool calls 95 -> 62, tokens 128518 -> 97274, agent-visible tool errors 51 -> 6
generous: task success baseline 19/20 vs guard 20/20 (McNemar exact p=1.0000)
generous: turns 107 -> 68, tool calls 104 -> 62, tokens 170601 -> 97158, agent-visible tool errors 51 -> 6
limitations: Deterministic fault injection, not observed production failures: each fault epoch fails the first 2 attempts of a logical call (timeout / HTTP 429 / HTTP 5xx).

The budgeted condition is a controlled stress condition: per-task turn budget = fault-free calibration turns + 1, so any fault epoch (2 extra turns for a baseline agent) exceeds it. Baseline budgeted success therefore approximates P(no transient fault) and must not be read as a production failure rate.
Single model (deepseek-v4-flash) and a single run per task per arm; McNemar is computed over the paired discordant outcomes only.

The single guard failure in the budgeted condition is an answer-formatting miss (population rounded to millions while the verifier requires the exact integer), not a middleware failure; it is left uncorrected in the artifact.
A repaired call is not retried when the repaired call itself hits a transient fault (found in the HN story_id tasks: 2 wasted turns each); left unchanged in this artifact.
Free public APIs are not production grade; the GitHub API was excluded because of the key-free rate limit, and API drift can affect reruns.
